imageSearchNotes: Checked the current 'Add a drillthrough action on a report' reference page, the overview 'Drillthrough reports' page, the 'Add a hyperlink to a URL' page (which documents the same Action-tab 'Go to report' option), and the full drillthrough/main-report tutorial.
